scenario: 今天基础设施赛道有 10 篇，4 篇有深度解读，主线是让大模型推理在显存紧张时省得下、跑得动。GateRQ 按门控决定每次查表读几级精度，把 Engram 记忆表压到原来的八分之一左右；WAKMan 按最近的流量在两种前缀缓存淘汰策略之间切换；折叠偏置的方法让压缩后的 KV cache 能直接交给 vLLM。eBay 先给图索引节点重新编号再压缩边，边存储省下约一半且查询不变慢。另有三值模型导出时的 bf16 舍入问题，以及 CUDA 13.4 的 GPU 显存隔离。做推理服务的团队可以先看折叠偏置和 WAKMan，做向量检索的团队可以先看 eBay 的图索引压缩。

papers.title: Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs
papers.authors: Tianqi Chen, Xunchao Li, Linchuan Xie, Guanghua Yu, Jianchen Zhu, Peisong Wang, Jian Cheng
papers.abstract: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per
papers.scoring_note: 门控残差量化，vLLM吞吐和知识保留验证
papers.summary: 给大模型的 n-gram 记忆表做低比特量化时，把精度留给访问最多的行反而比随机挑还差。原因在门控：DeepSeek 的 Engram 这类条件记忆层查出的向量要乘一个门控，常见虚词的门控很小，罕见实体名的门控很大，量化误差按门控放大。GateRQ 把每行存成几级单比特残差码，每次查表先读第一级算出门控，再在同一个 batch 里按门控估出的重要度排序，排在最前的一小部分读到第三级，其次的读到第二级，其余停在第一级；各级的比例由事先定好的平均读取比特数预算决定。不重训模型，DeepSeek 最新的 Flash 模型每张 GPU 上的表从 23.6 GiB 降到 3.0 GiB，省下的显存让长上下文吞吐比 FP8 表明显更高。

papers.title: WAKMan: Workload Aware KVCache Manager
papers.authors: Suhas Kumar Morisetty, Vaibhavi Lokegaonkar, Sachin Mathew Varghese, Wesley Harris
papers.abstract: Prefix caching enables a Large Language Model (LLM) servers to reuse the Key-Value (KV) states and accelerate prefill computation stage for requests that share a prefix with earlier prompts, thus reducing latency and serving cost. With limited memory resource, the KV cache eviction policy becomes a decisive factor in determining the overall benefits of prefix caching. Production traffic may have single-turn, multi-turn, agentic, or a mixture of any combination of these request types. Our findings indicate that agentic steps return within seconds and favor recency, while popular prompts and long conversations return after many other requests and favor frequency. Across 20 mixes, no single policy is always best: vLLM's default strategy LRU provides 12% higher cache hits as compared to the frequency-oriented S3FIFO on agentic-heavy mixes but trails it by up to 22% elsewhere, and even a single workload parameter can flip the winner even for any particular mix. We present WAKMan, a workload
papers.scoring_note: 前缀缓存淘汰适配流量，20种混合负载
papers.summary: vLLM 的前缀缓存该用哪种淘汰策略，取决于此刻的流量。agent 请求几秒后就带着同样的历史回来，默认的 LRU 正合适；热门系统提示和多轮对话的历史隔很久才回来，要靠优先保护反复被用的块的 S3FIFO 才留得住。作者在 20 种请求混合上实测，两种策略各有输赢。WAKMan 每 15 分钟把刚过去的流量在两套模拟缓存上各重放一遍，下一段时间用命中率更高的那套，平均比只用 LRU 多 5 个点的命中率。

papers.title: Folding Attention Biases into Keys Makes Compacted KV Caches Run on Standard Kernels
papers.abstract: Attention Matching (AM) compacts a KV cache by keeping some keys per head, refitting their values and adding a bias to each kept key's logit. FlashAttention and vLLM's paged caches have no input for it. We fold the bias into the keys along one closed-form direction per head, fitted on context queries, giving a plain cache with AM's size and head dimension and the model's own query path; the output error is bounded by how far each query's projection on that direction is from 1. With equal per-head budgets, unmodified vLLM serves folded caches through a KV connector, matching Hugging Face's answers on all 51 Qwen3-4B questions and its greedy output on 180 of 200 Qwen3-14B LongBench samples. With equal budgets on QuALITY (Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, 8B, Llama-3.1-8B) and LongHealth (three Qwen3 models), the fold is within noise of AM's accuracy in 13 of 14 settings, with lower KL to the full cache than dropping the bias in all 12 where both ran. Under the published per-head budgets, on Qwen3-4B, its
papers.scoring_note: 标准vLLM缓存兼容，多模型和长上下文验证
papers.summary: KV cache 压缩已能把长文档的缓存砍到十分之一，但效果最好的 Attention Matching 给每个保留的键向量加了一个偏置，vLLM 没有地方放它。这篇论文用读文档时产生的 query 为每个注意力头算出一个方向，让这些 query 在它上面的投影平均正好是 1，再把每个键向量沿它挪动一段与偏置成正比的距离，投影接近 1 的 query 看到的分数变化就约等于偏置。不改源码的 vLLM 在一张 T4 上同时装下的请求从 4 个变成 31 个。

papers.title: Lossless Compression of Proximity Graph Indexes for Efficient Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
papers.authors: Francesco Benocci, Leonard Dahlmann, Francesco Gargiulo, Tobias Heuer, Silvio Martinico, Franco Maria Nardini, Cosimo Rulli, Rossano Venturini
papers.abstract: Graph-based Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) indexes, such as HNSW, are the backbone of modern vector search. However, their massive memory footprint creates a severe infrastructure bottleneck. While vector quantization is widely adopted to reduce the memory required to store data vectors, the graph's edge structure increasingly dominates total memory usage. Compressing these adjacency lists for online search presents a critical system challenge: because decompression occurs during query processing, i.e., while navigating the graph, memory savings cannot come at the expense of query latency. In this paper, we present a compression technique explicitly tailored for live HNSW routing. By applying offline graph permutations to artificially induce structural locality, we enable the use of SIMD-accelerated integer compressors, such as Stream VByte, for rapid on-the-fly decompression. Evaluated across diverse real-world workloads, we significantly outperform the current state of the art in
papers.scoring_note: HNSW图结构无损压缩，直接降低索引内存
papers.summary: 向量检索的 HNSW 图索引里，向量本身已经常被量化压小，邻接表里的边反而成了内存大头，但边要在每次查询走图时现场解码，压缩不能拖慢查询。eBay 和比萨大学的这篇工作先离线给节点重新编号，让相邻节点的编号靠近，再用支持 SIMD 的整数压缩器 Stream VByte 现场解码。边存储最多省下 52.7%，延迟几乎不变；在 eBay 线上部署时，边存储最多减少 44.3%，查询延迟没有变差。

papers.title: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
papers.authors: Avichal Sahai, Nishant Raj, Animesh Srivastava
papers.abstract: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned through higher-precision latents and deployed as ternary codes by an export that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts latents to bf16. We audit releases from three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes (Falcon-E, BitCPM) and 1.530% (2B-4T); most Falcon-E and BitCPM disagreements are bf16 products exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints with ULP-matched rates, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% (Falcon-E-1B-Base) and 36.13% to 0.39% (BitCPM-CANN-0.5B), and a bf16 save and reload lowers 2B-4T's by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises at that endpoint. The strict decrease recurs at each of three new seeds in all three models
papers.scoring_note: bf16导出改变三值编码，跨实验室复现
papers.summary: 三值大模型发布时，导出流程先把潜在权重转成 bf16，这一步会悄悄抹掉小学习率微调学到的大部分改动。原因是微调更新的是高精度的潜在权重，只有潜在权重越过阈值（所在张量平均幅度的一半）时，对应的三值码才会改变；小学习率下，多数改动只比阈值多出一点点。而阈值附近 bf16 能表示的相邻数值隔得比这点改动还远，一转就把刚越过阈值的权重拉回原处。按文档流程导出后，Falcon-E-1B-Base 的 GSM8K 准确率从 58.79% 掉到 0.78%。

papers.title: ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization
papers.authors: Ning Yang, Bohan Cui, Zhuowen Liu, Yuting Wang
papers.abstract: Low-bit weight--activation quantization reduces the memory and computation needed to deploy large language models, but activation rounding can still degrade accuracy after calibration. Reconstruction from rounded inputs cannot distinguish activations within the same quantization bin. We propose ResCom, a low-rank correction that uses the activation rounding residual to compensate for the resulting layer-output error. An output-aware calibration procedure selects residual directions by their contribution to output reconstruction and computes the correction in closed form, without gradient training or updates to the calibrated weights. On Llama-3-8B with 4-bit weights and activations, rank-32 attention corrections reduce WikiText-2 perplexity from 7.708 to 7.147, improve MMLU by 2.89 percentage points, and raise five-shot GSM8K accuracy from 23.96 to 36.16 percent. Evaluations on models from 1B to 70B parameters and on held-out C4 test the method beyond this setting. The evaluated FP32 i
papers.scoring_note: 无梯度量化修正，多模型及定量质量验证
papers.summary: 权重和激活都量化到低比特后，同一个量化区间里的激活被取成同一个值，精度因此下降。ResCom 把激活被舍掉的残差拿回来补偿层输出误差。它在校准数据上统计残差的协方差，以及输出误差和残差的互协方差。先用前者把残差各维的尺度和相关性拉平，再对拉平后的互协方差矩阵做奇异值分解。取最能解释输出误差的几个方向，就直接得到低秩修正矩阵，不需要梯度训练。在 4 bit 权重和激活的 Llama-3-8B 上，五样本 GSM8K 准确率从 23.96% 提到 36.16%。

papers.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
papers.authors: Shuhuai Li, Shengdong Ye, Dongdong Ge, Yinyu Ye, Jianghao Lin
papers.abstract: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. Its value interface combines near-term tool readiness, node-specific cache credit with time-aware decay, and token footprint; a dynamic program jointly selects and places waiting sessions under capacity constraints. Across the 12 reported model-workload-concurrency settings, TAO reduces latency by up to 26.8%, reduces mean time to first token (TTFT) by up to 36.3%, and increases decode throughput by up to 29.5% relative to the best evaluated state-of-the-art baseline for each metric.
papers.scoring_note: 工具就绪联合调度，12组实验和延迟吞吐结果
papers.summary: agent 服务里，模型推理跑在 GPU 集群上，工具调用跑在分散的 CPU 上，现有调度器不看工具什么时候返回，也只用启发式规则决定哪些会话上 GPU、放在哪个节点。TAO 为每个会话和每个节点算三项：这个节点上缓存还能复用多少（随时间衰减），工具是否会在下个调度窗口内返回（按工具自己报告的进度或同类工具的历史耗时估算），会占多少 token。动态规划在容量限制下一起决定选谁、放哪，目标是让选中会话的缓存复用总量最大，平手时就绪的会话越多越好，再平手时偏向 token 多的。在 12 组模型、负载和并发设置里，首 token 平均延迟最多降低 36.3%。

papers.title: Layerwise Repacking: Variable-Length Hybrid-Attention Training without an Extra Redistribution Pass
papers.authors: Jiahao Zhang, Junwei Feng, Dongliang Huang, Xiaoling Zhou, Yiqiao Liao, Chengru Song
papers.abstract: Variable-length training creates conflicting parallelism requirements across the layers of a hybrid-attention model. The longest samples require wide sequence-parallel (SP) groups of 16 or 32 ranks for full attention, whose cost grows quadratically with sequence length. Sparse-attention layers, dominated by near-linear MoE work, can instead balance most evaluated workloads within node-local SP8 groups. Reusing the wide groups for these layers pushes their all-to-all communication across nodes, where the observed effective rate is 7.0x lower. Yet switching to smaller groups changes which ranks own each sample; a separate redistribution at every full-sparse boundary would introduce another data transfer. Layerwise Repacking keeps each SP16/32 parent for full attention and repacks its samples into node-local sparse children at SP{1, 2, 4, 8}, where hidden states persist between full layers. The layout change rides on the two existing full-layer Ulysses sites: at each, one variable-size al
papers.scoring_note: 混合注意力逐层重排，减少跨节点通信
papers.summary: 混合注意力模型做变长训练时，最长的样本在全注意力层需要几十张卡组成的大序列并行组，稀疏注意力层在单机小组里就能平衡。复用大组会让稀疏层通信跨机，单独再切换分组又要多搬一次数据。全注意力层本来就要做一次全交换通信来交换注意力头，Layerwise Repacking 在这次交换里顺便把样本重新分到单机小组，隐状态留在小组里直到下一个全注意力层，端到端训练时间平均缩短 7.61%。

papers.title: LoRA on a Budget: Function-Aware Post-Hoc Compression for Adapter Fleets
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a key mechanism for efficiently specializing foundation models into many task- and user-specific variants. Serving many LoRA adapters under a shared resource budget turns post-hoc compression into a two-level allocation problem: rank must be distributed across layers within each adapter and across adapters within the fleet. Although trained LoRAs contain substantial spectral redundancy, spectral reconstruction alone does not determine how much compression an adapter can functionally tolerate. We formulate fleet compression through a functional rank-distortion frontier for each adapter, followed by fleet-level minimax allocation under a shared rank budget. Given exact frontiers, this decomposition is equivalent to joint optimization over all layer ranks. We introduce Functional Rank Allocation (FRA), an unlabeled method for constructing practical frontiers. FRA measures isolated module truncations end to end, uses these measurements as an additive s
papers.scoring_note: LoRA模型群压缩，功能失真与预算分配
papers.summary: 同一个底座模型挂着大量 LoRA 适配器时，要在共享的秩预算下压缩它们，既要定每个适配器各层留多少秩，也要定预算在适配器之间怎么分。FRA 不用标注，拿一小批无标注输入，比较压缩前后适配器输出分布的差异（JS 散度），逐个截断模块测出这个差异，用动态规划拼出每个适配器的压缩曲线，再在整批适配器上做让最差者损失最小的分配。在 3 个公开集合共 78 个适配器上，预算紧时最差适配器的效果明显更好。

papers.title: Memory-Enforced GPU Sharing in Kubernetes with NVIDIA CUDA 13.4
papers.abstract: Many AI workloads need only a fraction of a GPU. Giving each one an entire device can leave capacity idle; sharing GPUs lets platform teams serve more workloads...
papers.scoring_note: CUDA内存强制隔离，Kubernetes共享部署实践
papers.summary: 很多 AI 任务只用得了一块 GPU 的一小部分，以往的共享方式里，轮流占用的时间片不限制显存，多进程并发的 MPS 也没有对应用透明的显存上限。NVIDIA 的这篇博客介绍 CUDA 13.4 新增的显存边界：任务申请多少就只能用多少，超出就分配失败，也可以设保底加可突发的上限。配套的开源 GPU Fractioning Operator 在 Kubernetes 节点上配置和监督 MPS，KAI Scheduler v0.18.0 负责按注解把分数 GPU 分给各个容器。
